title: Appliance Repair Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Appliance Repair: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Appliance Repair Estimate Worksheet covers household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish. The home appliance service coordinator records Residential Appliance Repair observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Appliance Repair Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the home appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Estimate Worksheet at residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area. Document household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish identity before Residential Appliance Repair begins. Compare household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish findings with stated Residential Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance technician. For Appliance Repair Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance technician to review Residential Appliance Repair conditions beyond the home appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Pricing evidence and service location
sections.guidance: For Residential Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area, and the linked household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish source.

sections.title: Estimated scope, options, and pricing
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Appliance Repair facts for household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

items: Power, gas, water, drain, and vent connection

sections.title: Estimate assumptions and customer decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Appliance Repair conditions; have home appliance service coordinator assign the next Residential Appliance Repair owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, water, refrigerant, or combustion concern
Property damage or test condition outside scope
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, part concern, property risk, or unsafe test remains. Retain the available Residential Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish scope to home appliance service coordinator.
